$comment: Generated by scripts/sdss/build.py. Do not edit by hand.
layout: int16 little-endian quadruples (x, y, z, redshift); any prefix is a fair random subsample
frame: galactic; three.js +x toward the Galactic centre, +y north galactic pole, +z toward l = 270 deg

selection.query: SELECT specObjID, ra, dec, z FROM SpecObj WHERE class='GALAXY' AND zWarning=0 AND z>0.01 AND z<0.8 AND (fiberID % 9)=0
selection.queryNear: SELECT specObjID, ra, dec, z FROM SpecObj WHERE class='GALAXY' AND zWarning=0 AND z>0.01 AND z<0.1
selection.subsample: near: every galaxy with z < 0.1; far: the one-in-nine query at z >= 0.1; each part's first KEEP rows in splitmix64(specObjID) order, written together in that order

credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) DR20 spectroscopic galaxies; acknowledgements on the Sources page
reference: Kollmeier et al. 2026, AJ 171, 52 (SDSS-V overview; arXiv:2507.06989)
